[[Sorin Schaff]], the chief backer of the [[Citizens' Militia]], owned a '''homestead''' on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:PB" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Schaff was held captive in his own home by [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Braigin Helk]].<ref name="TOR:PB" />
